tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search Naver News by keyword. Returns article title, link, original publisher link, and publication date.

params.name: sort
params.description: 'sim' for relevance (default), 'date' for newest-first.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query. Must be UTF-8 encoded.

params.name: start
params.description: Result offset (1-indexed). Default 1, max 1000.

params.name: display
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Default 10, max 100.

tools.name: search_local
tools.description: Search Naver Local for restaurants, shops, and points of interest. Returns business name, address, phone, category, and map coordinates.

params.name: sort
params.description: 'random' (default) or 'comment' (sort by review count).

params.name: query
params.description: Search query. Must be UTF-8 encoded.

params.name: start
params.description: Result offset. Local search supports only start=1.

params.name: display
params.description: Max 5 results per call for the local endpoint.

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Image search across Naver's image index. Returns thumbnail and full-size image URLs.

params.name: sort
params.description: 'sim' (relevance, default) or 'date' (newest).

params.name: query
params.description: Search query. Must be UTF-8 encoded.

params.name: start
params.description: Result offset (1-indexed). Default 1, max 1000.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter by image size: 'all' (default), 'large', 'medium', 'small'.

params.name: display
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Default 10, max 100.

tools.name: search_shopping
tools.description: Search Naver Shopping's product catalog. Returns product title, price, mall name, and product page link.

params.name: sort
params.description: 'sim' (relevance), 'date' (newest), 'asc' (price asc), 'dsc' (price desc).

params.name: query
params.description: Search query. Must be UTF-8 encoded.

params.name: start
params.description: Result offset (1-indexed). Default 1, max 1000.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter by product type: 'naverpay' for Naver Pay-eligible only.

params.name: display
params.description: Number of results per page. Default 10, max 100.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Exclude product types: 'used', 'rental', or 'cbshop' (cross-border).
